Name: Shephathiah, Father of Meshullam
Summary: Father of Meshullam in the Jerusalem list, son of Reuel son of Ibnijah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Father of Meshullam in the Jerusalem list, son of Reuel son of Ibnijah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shephathiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
